target_semantics_lesson: Focus on Microsoft's quarterly year-over-year revenue growth acceleration for the fiscal quarter ending 2023-12-31, not just general growth.
evidence_selection_lesson: Require current, cutoff-safe data for cloud performance, AI initiatives, and Surface business weakness to validate causal links.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Evaluate growth acceleration by weighing strong cloud/AI drivers against Surface business weakness. The net effect determines the acceleration.
counterevidence_lesson: Acknowledge Surface business weakness as a potential drag on revenue growth, requiring assessment of its impact relative to growth drivers.
calibration_lesson: Quantify AI and cloud impact, and Surface drag. Uncertainty in these magnitudes reduces confidence in the precise acceleration level.
